query: Update my AI-Agent-skills to the latest versions.
expected_behavior: Reports per agent which skills were updated (old -> new) and which were already current
Mentions that updated skills take effect in the next session

query: Are my skills up to date?
expected_behavior: Runs the update check (or --list --agent comparison) rather than guessing
Only reports on skills originating from the AI-Agent-skills repo - other skills are out of scope
Offers to apply available updates rather than applying silently if the user only asked to check

query: I don't have Node on this machine - can I still update the skills?
expected_behavior: Offers the no-Node fallback: git pull in a local clone, then install.ps1 -Agent all -Update -Yes (or install.sh --agent all --update --yes)
Reminds that the comparison is against the local clone, so pull first
Does not attempt to install Node without asking
